confounds_reason: Depth, and structurally rather than empirically. Width is directly refuted as a MECHANICAL term: BI is a cosine of two vectors in the same space and the contribution is ||dh||/||h||, both exactly invariant to the ambient dimension, and the analytic anchors above are identical at D = 6, 16 and 768. The depth association is the papers' own finding (deeper models have more redundant layers), but it means the scalar cannot be read as a size-free property.

DESIGN: `effective_depth_90` is decided by the embedding -> block-0 transition, whose contribution is 14x to 251x the per-model median of the remaining layers (10.64 vs 0.263 on gpt2, 33.55 vs 0.134 on gpt2-medium).
